question: By whose agency and will does the yogini named Iccha extend up to maya?
premises: The yogini named Iccha is mentioned
The siddhas act by supreme will up to the limit of maya
inference: Through the siddhas and by supreme will, the yogini Iccha extends up to maya.
uncertainties: The verbal action is implied rather than explicitly stated.
plain_english: The yogini named Iccha, by the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to maya.
